# Music Font Sources

All music fonts in this directory are SMuFL-compliant and released under open-source licenses.

## Open-Source Fonts (SIL Open Font License)

### Bravura
- **Source**: https://github.com/steinbergmedia/bravura
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `vendor/bravura-1.211/otf/Bravura.otf`, `vendor/bravura-1.211/otf/BravuraText.otf`
- **Description**: SMuFL reference font by Steinberg (Dorico). Modern, clean engraving style.

### Petaluma
- **Source**: https://github.com/steinbergmedia/petaluma
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `Petaluma.otf`, `PetalumaText.otf`
- **Description**: Handwritten-style font by Steinberg. Jazz-chart / hand-engraved aesthetic.

### Leland
- **Source**: https://github.com/MuseScoreFonts/Leland
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `Leland.otf`, `LelandText.otf`
- **Description**: Default font for MuseScore 4. Contemporary engraving style.

### Sebastian
- **Source**: https://github.com/fkretlow/sebastian
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `Sebastian.otf`, `SebastianText.otf`
- **Description**: Elegant engraver-style font by Florian Kretlow.

### Golden Age
- **Source**: https://github.com/benwiggy/GoldenAge
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `GoldenAge.otf`
- **Description**: Historical/vintage style font by Ben Finn. No companion text font.

### Leipzig
- **Source**: https://github.com/rism-digital/leipzig
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `Leipzig.otf`
- **Description**: Academic/scholarly font by RISM Digital. No companion text font.

### Finale Maestro
- **Source**: https://makemusic.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500013053461-MakeMusic-Fonts-and-Licensing-Information
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `FinaleMaestro.otf`, `FinaleMaestroText-Regular.otf`, `FinaleMaestroText-Bold.otf`, `FinaleMaestroText-Italic.otf`, `FinaleMaestroText-BoldItalic.otf`
- **Description**: Classic engraver-style font by MakeMusic (Finale). Full text font weight/style variants.

### Finale Broadway
- **Source**: https://makemusic.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500013053461-MakeMusic-Fonts-and-Licensing-Information
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `FinaleBroadway.otf`, `FinaleBroadwayText.otf`, `FinaleBroadwayLegacyText.otf`
- **Description**: Broadway/show music style by MakeMusic.

### Finale Ash
- **Source**: https://makemusic.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500013053461-MakeMusic-Fonts-and-Licensing-Information
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `FinaleAsh.otf`, `FinaleAshText.otf`
- **Description**: Hand-drawn/manuscript style by MakeMusic.

### Finale Engraver
- **Source**: https://makemusic.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500013053461-MakeMusic-Fonts-and-Licensing-Information
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `FinaleEngraver.otf`
- **Description**: Traditional engraving style by MakeMusic. No companion text font.

### Finale Jazz
- **Source**: https://makemusic.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500013053461-MakeMusic-Fonts-and-Licensing-Information
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `FinaleJazz.otf`, `FinaleJazzText.otf`, `FinaleJazzTextLowercase.otf`

### Finale Legacy
- **Source**: https://makemusic.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500013053461-MakeMusic-Fonts-and-Licensing-Information
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1

### Finale Lyrics
- **Source**: https://makemusic.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500013053461-MakeMusic-Fonts-and-Licensing-Information
- **License**: SIL OFL 1.1
- **Files**: `FinaleLyrics-Regular.otf`, `FinaleLyrics-Italic.otf`, `FinaleLyrics-Bold.otf`
- **Description**: Dedicated lyrics font by MakeMusic. Not currently wired up as a text font.
